name: Bloodpetal Sprouts
label: Quest
description: Bloodpetal Sprouts: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Here's the plan, friend: Go out and collect some bloodpetal sprouts -- you know, the plants that haven't fully sprouted yet, and bring them here. Then I'll see what the Atal'ai haze can do.
You may think I'm vengeful... Actually, you'd be right about that!
Truth is, I know the way out of here, but until Larion will admit that I'm right, I'm staying right here!
So off with you, find those bloodpetal sprouts and let's have some fun!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here goes nothing, friend! This will get Larion's attention!
